output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, The Walt Disney Company's latest published quarterly financial statements are its Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q, filed August 5, 2026, covering the quarter and nine months ended June 27, 2026: https://s206.q4cdn.com/979796730/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/6cb3fe4e-d0ee-4bbf-84e5-17cc436ed37e.pdf. For that quarter, Disney reported revenue of $25.248 billion, net income attributable to Disney of $2.638 billion, and diluted earnings per share of $1.51. Its latest audited annual financial statements are in the FY2025 Form 10-K, filed November 13, 2025, for the year ended September 27, 2025: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1744489/000174448925000155/dis-20250927.htm. Q4 and full-year FY2026 results are scheduled for November 17, 2026, so they are not yet the latest available statements.
caveats: The Q3 FY2026 interim financial statements are unaudited; the FY2025 annual statements are audited. November 17, 2026 is a scheduled release date, not an already published set of results.
